title: Control Your Psychotic Child: Stochastic Guardrails for Coding Agents
description: How do you put guardrails on a coding agent that's a psychotic child — confidently, fluently wrong several times a day? The devlog discovery of stochastic correctness and the audit barrage: a panel of rival model CLIs cross-examining every diff. The most useful guardrail I've built for coding agents — and I didn't design it, I bred it.
